roots.rationale: Injected journalOf uses strings.NewReader; capturePublish only decodes/appends in memory. Minute sequencing, classes, oversized accounting and silent windows are local assertions; no journal process or NATS publication.
Injected command immediately returns the synthetic sentinel error; followLogs returns before opening a journal or publishing.
Direct logRetry.failed calls with synthetic durations and errors assert local backoff doubling, cap and reset; logging is incidental.

Injected command/ticks/publisher and atomic clock assert retries, windows and cancellation. blockingJournal uses io.Pipe (Go in-memory reader/writer), not an OS pipe; no journalctl or NATS connection.
strings.NewReader plus callback records oversized markers and EOF; only local buffering/line splitting.
In-memory BackupOperationRecord marshaling asserts a one-MiB serializer bound. Proof/DER/terminal data are size placeholders, not validated committed R3 proof or store I/O.
Local relay matching and signed outer-frame serializers assert size caps. Inner proofs are explicitly signed-envelope-shaped size models; no controller listener, NATS exchange or KV access.
Golden fixture read is incidental input to local relay predicates, serialization sizes and locally signed/verified outer frames; no host protocol exchange or committed store readback.

Production readManagedBackupMaterial reaches protected file Lstat/Open/Fstat/read/digest verification and peer secret-file absence/type/mode guards. Independent allowlist and golden digest assertions are unit-only; target/source/alias comparisons remain local semantic checks after input loading. No S3/Vault traffic.

Conditional on root: production prepareManagedBackupFiles installs root-owned protected files with Openat/Fchown/write/sync/Renameat2; readManagedClientFile reads exact bytes and metadata back; retry verifies existing files. Independent synthetic resolver call counts and wrong-key pre-install hash guard are unit evidence. Resolvers are fixtures, not Vault.

Real upstream NATS server, loopback TCP client, JetStream KV writes/leader reads and signed Agent request/replies support pending/abort/status/renewal/process-bound command assertions. Independent backupProcessLocallyRecovered table and MatchesContainer replacement guards are local unit blocks. R3 reader/verifiers are synthetic and container kernel identity is manually constructed; no actual restart/container/backup execution.
Direct command.matchesRecord over synthetic records asserts exact envelope, roster/kind/size and abort precedence predicates; no R3 store/host network.
backupRelayEnvelope and JSON marshaling over synthetic Cut DER/Complete payloads assert size limits locally; no KV write, real certificate validation or transport.

Production loader reads pinned protected files, checks actual key mode and rejects an actual FIFO using nonblocking no-follow open. Independent address tables and deterministic path rejection are local semantic assertions; their file setup is incidental. No TLS listener starts.

Production loader reads the pinned SQL bundle and checks mismatched digest against actual bytes. Independent missing-pin and unsafe/conflicting socket semantic guards are unit blocks. Bundle bytes are synthetic; no SQL server/schema execution.
Direct validateDesired table and withdrawal checks cover local memory and identity validation, using synthetic registration/desired values. No cgroup or process boundary.

Production validateManagedHostMemoryAt reads actual temp meminfo/membership/controller/memory.max files and traverses ancestors. Separate direct physicalMemoryBytes overflow check is unit-only. Files represent a cgroup hierarchy; no kernel cgroup limits are applied.

memoryRunner is a map-backed fake; injected memoryCheck proves reserve mismatch rejects before memory inspection, stops fake running role and never applies. No process/cgroup/runtime I/O is reached; native-root cleanup sees an empty map.
Direct validateDesiredReply and sameDesiredReplyBinding calls assert local revisions, registration generation and identity comparisons. No NATS request or controller state is read.

Production readCgroupMemoryMax reads actual memory.max file content for each value and returns parsed limit/error. Local filesystem boundary materially supports asserted readback, without actual cgroup enforcement.

classification_definitions.integration: Core asserted target materially traverses actual production filesystem read/write or service/protocol/store I/O.
classification_definitions.unit: Local predicate/serialization/clock/concurrency/synthetic feed; incidental fixture reads and setup do not establish integration.
classification_definitions.mixed: Distinct independent unit-only blocks and materially asserted production I/O blocks coexist in the root.
classification_definitions.unresolved: Missing source/mapping or blocked intended assertion; runtime unknown is separately retained.

func managedContractFixture() (Registration, Desired, ed25519.PrivateKey) {
	key := ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed(make([]byte, ed25519.SeedSize))
	registration := Registration{
		ID:   entityid.Derive("host", "gru", "node-a"),
		Cell: "gru", Node: "node-a", Environment: "production", FailureDomain: "FAULT-DOMAIN-1",
		Roles: []string{"terrabase"}, PublicKey: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(key.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey)), NATSUserPublicKey: testNATSUserKey("node-a"), Generation: 1,
		Capacity: Capacity{MemoryBytes: 8 << 30}, SystemReserveBytes: 1 << 30,
		ManagedOCI:    &ManagedOCIBinding{Region: "GRU", InstanceID: "ocid1.instance.oc1..node-a", Owner: "terrascale", FleetGeneration: 1, CreateKey: "00000000000000000000000001"},
		ManagedMember: &ManagedMemberBinding{Scope: MemberScope{ClusterID: "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", TenantID: "01HW000000E008000000000001", DatabaseID: "01HW000000E008000000000001", ShardID: 1, MemberID: "01HW000000E008000000000001", Incarnation: "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb"}, HostAttempt: 1},
	}
	desired := Desired{Cell: "gru", Node: "node-a", Environment: "production", Role: "terrabase", Generation: 1, AuthorityEpoch: 1, Digest: strings.Repeat("a", 64),
		ManagedMember: &ManagedMemberLaunch{OCI: *registration.ManagedOCI, Member: *registration.ManagedMember,
			Authority:    MemberAuthority{Epoch: 1, ConfigurationID: strings.Repeat("c", 64), CertificateSHA256: strings.Repeat("d", 64), TLSLeafSHA256: strings.Repeat("e", 64)},
			SourceDigest: strings.Repeat("f", 64), VolumeID: "ocid1.volume.retained", AttachmentID: "ocid1.volumeattachment.node-a",

	return registration, desired, key
}
